message.reasoning_content: Describe: kernel prunes residual; question is whether omitted ReLU residual stays within 1.0 over whole box. Need max of residual sum. Weights entries ±{0.5,1}, b=0.75*sum|w|. Activation possible when dot(W,x)>b; max dot ≤ sum|w| = b/0.75, so max excess = 0.25*sum|w|. Sum over 6 neurons of 0.25*c[j]*excess. c=0.25 each. Worst-case residual bound: for each neuron, excess ≤ 0.25*S_j where S_j=sum|W[j]|. Total ≤ 0.25*0.25*sum S_j. With |W[j]| entries in {0.5,1}, S_j between 6 and 12, sum_j S_j ≤ 72, giving residual ≤ 0.0625*72=4.5 potentially > 1.0. But can all neurons simultaneously activate maximally with a single x? Depends on signs. That's the key risk. Record description update.
